title: Making an infinite craft inspired card game where you can battle your friends!
author: 11thDrBOT
selftext: On top of crafting we added some semantic based battle modes and crafting quests. Looking forward to hear what you think of this!

comments.author: 11thDrBOT
comments.body: You can play the demo here: [https://entropedia.xyz](https://entropedia.xyz)

comments.author: VanillaMammoth1937
comments.body:
Pretty cool game idea, and I commend you for making it. But, honestly, I tried it out for like 3 minutes, and I think the UI needs a lot of work still. Things are jerky and not animated smoothly. In the tutorial, the hand moves behind the cookbook, so you can't see it, and it looks weird. It took me like 5 attempts to even drag an ingredient into the cauldron.

Also, certain graphical elements (like the potion in the cauldron, for example) look very unnatural and kind of take you out. And some of the assets just look slightly blurry. Maybe they would benefit if you just run them through an image upscaler.

If you made some of these changes, I think it would be a fun game

replies.author: 11thDrBOT
replies.body:
thank you for testing it out! We still have a lot of polish to do in the onboarding yes haha  
we did a first shot with an artist for the art direction but the assets will be updated some time in the future if enough people want to play the game
